records.title: Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models
records.reason: The arXiv abstract identifies RLTT as a training-time reward/credit-assignment framework and reports accuracy gains under identical training and inference conditions.

records.title: Long-range electrostatics in atomistic machine learning: a physical perspective
records.reason: The publisher/arXiv abstract concerns long-range electrostatics and atomistic machine learning for physical systems.

records.title: Protein Language Model Embeddings Improve Generalization of Implicit Transfer Operators
records.reason: The full text evaluates embeddings in molecular transfer-operator estimation and molecular dynamics. Its efficiency discussion concerns protein simulation/modeling, not autoregressive language-model inference or a serving method transferable to this scope.

records.title: Decentralized Attention Fails Centralized Signals: Rethinking Transformers for Medical Time Series
